name: crebain
description: Research-only spatial visualization, simulation, and sensor-fusion prototype
author: Sepehr Mahmoudian <sepmhn@gmail.com>

scripts.build: bun run check:phase0-baseline && bun run typecheck && bunx --bun vite build && bun run check:production-boundary
scripts.check:release-tools: scripts/check-version-coherence.sh && scripts/test-version-coherence.sh && bun run check:audit-tools && bun run check:bundle-tool
scripts.check:nix-deps: bunx --bun bun2nix | node scripts/normalize-bun-nix.mjs | cmp bun.nix - && node scripts/test-normalize-bun-nix.mjs
scripts.check:plant-frames: node scripts/verify-plant-frame-conventions.mjs && node scripts/test-plant-frame-conventions.mjs && cargo test --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p crebain-plant-authority --test frame_golden_vectors
scripts.check:managed-simulation-boundary: node scripts/check-managed-simulation-boundary.mjs && node scripts/test-managed-simulation-boundary.mjs && python3 scripts/test-build-managed-simulation-bootstrap.py && python3 scripts/test-stage-managed-simulation-package.py && python3 scripts/test-pack-managed-simulation-package.py && python3 scripts/test-sync-managed-simulation-engram-contracts.py
scripts.check:managed-simulation-contract: cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p crebain-managed-simulation && python3 scripts/generate-managed-simulation-transcript.py --binary src-tauri/target/release/crebain-managed-simulation --verify integrations/engram/managed-simulation/sample-transcript.json && python3 scripts/test-check-installed-managed-simulation-v3.py && python3 scripts/test-run-managed-simulation-real-nest-proof.py
scripts.doc:managed-simulation: RUSTDOCFLAGS='-D warnings' cargo doc --locked --release --no-deps --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p crebain-managed-simulation
scripts.clippy:ncp-headless: cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p crebain-ncp-headless --features ncp --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.self-check:ncp-headless: cargo run --quiet --locked --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -p crebain-ncp-headless --features ncp --bin crebain-ncp-headless -- self-check
scripts.validate: bun run check:phase0-baseline && bun run check:product-profiles && bun run check:ipc-contracts && bun run check:release-tools && bun run check:docs-visuals && bun run check:vendor-compat && bun run check:ros-defs && bun run check:nix-deps && bun run check:production-vendors && bun run check:responsive-tool && bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:run
scripts.validate:all: bun run check:ncp-coherence && bun run validate && bun run check:managed-simulation-boundary && bun run check:managed-simulation-inputs && bun run check:managed-simulation-contract && bun run fmt:managed-simulation:check && bun run check:managed-simulation-rust && bun run test:managed-simulation && bun run clippy:managed-simulation && bun run doc:managed-simulation && bun run validate:ncp-simulation && bun run fmt:rust:check && bun run check:plant-boundary && bun run check:plant-frames && bun run fmt:plant:check && bun run check:plant && bun run test:plant && bun run clippy:plant && bun run self-check:plant && bun run check:rust && bun run test:rust && bun run clippy:rust && bun run check:ncp-headless-boundary && bun run check:ncp-headless && bun run clippy:ncp-headless && bun run test:ncp-headless && bun run self-check:ncp-headless && bun run clippy:rust:ncp && bun run test:rust:ncp
scripts.validate:ncp-simulation: bun run fmt:ncp-simulation:check && bun run check:ncp-simulation && bun run test:ncp-simulation && bun run clippy:ncp-simulation && bun run doc:ncp-simulation
scripts.validate:with-ncp-sensors: bun run validate:ncp-sensors && bun run validate:all
